name: Modor DR-2
description: Modor DR-2 drum synthesizer: the controllers of its six drums, and every other drum parameter by NRPN.

sources.title: Modor DR-2 user manual, version 6 for firmware OS014
sources.notes: The MIDI controller list (PDF pages 93 - 97) and the NRPN table, read by tools/profiles/modor/read-modor-manual.mjs from UsersManualDR-2.pdf (sha256 0e666333cb65b650153d40b9a897dd7a25a63a44aebc9e89f9ae4c0dd4f9f160), https://modormusic.com/downloads/UsersManualDR-2.pdf, linked from https://modormusic.com/downloads.html. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/modor/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/modor/synths/, not this file.

Every parameter is a row of the manual's MIDI controller list that it marks Received, sent as its controller on the channel variable, and each drum's parameters the list gives no controller as their NRPN (MSB the drum, LSB the parameter, the value on CC 6), which is what the manual says its NRPNs are for. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
Each is sent 0 - 127: the manual gives the panel's ranges (`[0,127]`, `[-64,+63]`, coarse tuning `[-32,+31]`) but not how a controller's value maps onto them.

The NRPNs that set what a drum's controller sets are not laid out a second time: 0 Pitch ENV decay (Pitch Env Decay), 3 Amp decay (Amp Decay), 4 Pitch ENV curve (Pitch Env Curve), 7 Amp ENV curve (Amp Curve), 9 Volume (Volume), 10 Pan (Pan), 11 Pitch/Tune (Pitch), 12 Pitch ENV amount (Pitch Env Amount), 13 X parameter (X), 14 Y parameter (Y), 15 Z parameter (Z), 16 T parameter (T).
The X, Y, Z and T parameters mean what the drum's model makes them (§3.1); the profile names them as the list does.

Left out, and named: MIDI's own, Bank Select (CC 0), NRPN Data (CC 6), NRPN Data Increment (CC 96), NRPN Data Decrement (CC 97), NRPN LSB (Select Parameter) (CC 98), NRPN MSB (Select Instrument) (CC 99); the rows the list prints as not received, CC Start/Stop (CC 44).

coverage.editBufferDumpParse: notImplemented: the manual describes SysEx dumps without their format
coverage.inboundControllers: the instrument sends the controllers the list marks Transmitted when its knobs turn; not mapped
